semantics.summary: 5.0.0-i4 inserted pm_probe into struct dev_rsrc, which is also consumed by the precompiled fantgpu.o_shipped at fixed offsets. Booting 6.12.101 then faulted in fixup_pcie_init. This correction restores the i3 dev_rsrc layout exactly and keeps the same per-device probe state in a separate devres allocation with the existing PM/remove/debugfs serialization.

license.evidence: F-only correction in the same two vendor Dual MIT/GPLv2 source files; no binary or third-party content changed.

dependencies.summary: Applies only after the 030-032 diagnostic probe and preserves its command, permission, lifecycle and one-shot behavior.

o_stage_adaptation.summary: No D-side source. fantgpu.o_shipped remains byte-identical; the correction removes the source/binary layout disagreement instead of modifying the shipped object.

apply.result: 2 files changed (fantgpu/fantgpu_pci_drv.c, fantgpu/hal.h); no .orig/.rej; fresh replay tree hash == after_tree_hash

rollback.command: remove O_stage and re-extract chain base (F0 snapshot + 030-001..030-032, 16 entries); do not reverse-edit F0
